_provenance.modeling_note: Passive towed array for the Virginia SSN, distinct from the LAB bow sonar mount as required by the authoring standard (bow/flank/towed as separate mounts). Detection ranges and source levels are not public (R18/R19); values are engineering estimates following the same towed-array-vs-hull-sonar scaling logic used for CSG_US_TB-37U_Towed_Array, adjusted slightly for a quieter nuclear submarine platform (lower ambient_noise_db, lower self_noise_per_speed_db).

sonar.max_range_m.note: not public (R18/R19); engineering estimate, towed-array scaling from the SSN LAB bow sonar baseline

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to CSG_US_TB-37U_Towed_Array's DDG towed-array baseline

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the TB-37U baseline, reflecting a quieter SSN platform

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: engineering estimate: towed line arrays have higher directivity gain than a hull-mounted bow array, close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate better than the TB-37U baseline, reflecting the quieter Virginia SSN platform vs a surface DDG

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate better than the TB-37U baseline, same quieter-platform reasoning

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active source level applies

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active source-level speed dependency

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the TB-37U baseline (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m, close to TB-37U baseline

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: 0.0: towed array trails well astern of the hull's own baffles, consistent with the TB-37U record's convention

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the TB-37U baseline

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active ping capability modeled

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.passive_only.note: TB-34/29/33 towed arrays have no active transmit mode

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: modern towed arrays support range estimation via multi-array triangulation/TMA, not bearing-only, consistent with the TB-37U record's convention
